records.label: Autosave Support
records.notes: WordPress documents autosave as an explicit support; editor support implies autosave for backward compatibility.

records.label: Disable All Core Supports
records.notes: Represents register_post_type supports=false rather than a fake individual WordPress feature.

records.label: Structured Support Feature Arguments
records.notes: WordPress allows a support feature to be specified with an arguments array. WPE should expose typed/registered feature argument schemas, not arbitrary executable configuration.

records.label: Built-in Post Type Flag
records.notes: WordPress marks this argument FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY. Captured in the Bank so it cannot be mistaken for a missing product option.

records.label: Internal Edit Link Template
records.notes: WordPress marks this argument FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY. Not a normal user-facing WPE option.

coverage.notes: Current native extras and internal-only exclusions captured from register_post_type().
